H1403.def: from «01397» and «0410»; man of God; Gabriel, an archangel:--Garbriel.

H1405.def: intensive from «01389»; a hilly spot; Gibbethon, a place in Palestine:--Gibbethon.

H1406.def: probably by reduplication from «01342»; a roof; by analogy, the top of an altar:--roof (of the house), (house) top (of the house).

H1407.def: from «01413» (in the sense of cutting); coriander seed (from its furrows):--coriander.

H1408.def: a variation of «01409»; Fortune, a Babylonian deity:--that troop.

H1409.def: from «01464» (in the sense of distributing); fortune:--troop.

H1410.def: from «01464»; Gad, a son of Jacob, including his tribe and its territory; also a prophet:--Gad.

H1412.et: by reduplication from (01413) (in the sense of cutting)
H1412.def: by reduplication from «01413» (in the sense of cutting) cleft; Gudgodah, a place in the Desert:--Gudgodah.

H1413.def: a primitive root (compare «01464»); to crowd; also to gash (as if by pressing into):--assemble (selves by troops), gather (selves together, self in troops), cut selves.

H1414.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «01413»; to cut down:--hew down.

H1415.et: from an unused root (meaning to cut off)
H1415.def: from an unused root (meaning to cut off); a border of a river (as cut into by the stream):--bank.

H1416.def: from «01413»; a crowd (especially of soldiers):--army, band (of men), company, troop (of robbers).

H1417.def: or (feminine) gdudah {ghed-oo-daw'}; from «01413»; a furrow (as cut):--furrow.

H1418.def: feminine participle passive of «01413»; an incision:--cutting.

H1419.def: or (shortened) gadol {gaw-dole'}; from «01431»; great (in any sense); hence, older; also insolent:--+ aloud, elder(-est), + exceeding(-ly), + far, (man of) great (man, matter, thing,-er,-ness), high, long, loud, mighty, more, much, noble, proud thing, × sore, (X ) very.

H1420.def: or (shortened) gdullah {ghed-ool-law'}; or (less accurately) gduwllah {ghed-ool-law'}; feminine of «01419»; greatness; (concretely) mighty acts:--dignity, great things(-ness), majesty.

H1421.def: or (shortened) gidduph {ghid-doof'}; and (feminine) gidduphah {ghid-doo-faw'}; or gidduphah {ghid-doo-faw'}; from «01422»; vilification:--reproach, reviling.

H1422.def: feminine passive participle of «01442»; a revilement:--taunt.

H1423.def: from the same as «01415»; a young goat (from browsing):--kid.

H1425.def: patronymically from «01410»; a Gadite (collectively) or descendants of Gad:--Gadites, children of Gad.

H1427.def: from «01409» and «0410»; fortune of God; Gaddiel, an Israelite:--Gaddiel.

H1428.def: or gadyah {gad-yaw'}; the same as «01415»; a river brink:--bank.

H1429.def: feminine of «01423»; a young female goat:--kid.

H1430.et: from an unused root (meaning to heap up)
H1430.def: from an unused root (meaning to heap up); a stack of sheaves; by analogy, a tomb:--shock (stack) (of corn), tomb.

H1431.def: a primitive root; properly, to twist (compare «01434»), i.e. to be (causatively make) large (in various senses, as in body, mind, estate or honor, also in pride):--advance, boast, bring up, exceed, excellent, be(-come, do, give, make, wax), great(-er, come to...estate, + things), grow(up),increase, lift up, magnify(-ifical), be much set by, nourish (up), pass, promote, proudly (spoken), tower.

H1433.def: from «01431»; magnitude (literally or figuratively):-- greatness, stout(-ness).

H1434.def: from «01431» (in the sense of twisting); thread, i.e. a tassel or festoon:--fringe, wreath.

H1435.def: from «01431»; stout; Giddel, the name of one of the Nethinim, also of one of "Solomon's servants":--Giddel.

H1436.def: or (prolonged) Gdalyahuw {ghed-al-yaw'- hoo}; from «01431» and «03050»; Jah has become great; Gedaljah, the name of five Israelites:--Gedaliah.

H1437.def: from «01431»; I have made great; Giddalti, an Israelite:--Giddalti.

H1438.def: a primitive root; to fell a tree; generally, to destroy anything:--cut (asunder, in sunder, down, off), hew down.

H1439.def: from «01438»; feller (i.e. warrior); Gidon, an Israelite:--Gideon.

H1440.def: from «01438»; a cutting (i.e. desolation); Gidom, a place in Palestine:--Gidom.

H1442.def: a primitive root; to hack (with words), i.e. revile:--blaspheme, reproach.

H1443.def: a primitive root; to wall in or around:--close up, fence up, hedge, inclose, make up (a wall), mason, repairer.

H1445.def: : the same as «01444»; Geder, a place in Palestine:--Geder.

H1446.def: or (fully) Gdowr {ghed-ore'}; from «01443»; inclosure; Gedor, a place in Palestine; also the name of three Israelites:--Gedor.

H1447.def: from «01443»; a circumvallation; by implication, an inclosure:--fence, hedge, wall.

H1448.def: feminine of «01447»; enclosure (especially for flocks):--(sheep-) cote (fold) hedge, wall.

H1449.def: the same as «01448»; (with the article) Gederah, a place in Palestine:--Gederah, hedges.

H1450.def: plural of «01448»; walls; Gederoth, a place in Palestine:--Gederoth.

H1451.def: patrial from «01445»; a Gederite, or inhabitant of Geder:--Gederite.

H1452.def: patrial from «01449»; a Gederathite, or inhabitant of Gederah:--Gederathite.

H1453.def: dual of «01448»; double wall; Gederothajim, a place in Palestine:--Gederothaim.

H1454.def: probably a clerical error for «02088»; this:--this.

H1455.def: a primitive root; to remove (a bandage from a wound, i.e. heal it):--cure.

H1457.def: a primitive root; to prostrate oneself:--cast self down, stretch self.

H1459.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «01460»; the middle:--midst, same, there- (where-) in.

H1460.def: from «01342» (corresponding to «01354»); the back; by analogy, the middle:--+ among, back, body.

H1462.def: from «01461»; the locust (from its grubbing as a larvae):-- grasshopper, × great.

H1463.def: of uncertain derivation; Gog, the name of an Israelite, also of some nothern nation:--Gog.

H1464.def: a primitive root (akin to «01413»); to crowd upon, i.e. attack:--invade, overcome.

H1465.def: feminine of «01460»; the back, i.e. (by extensive) the person:--body.

H1466.def: the same as «01465»; exaltation; (figuratively) arrogance:--lifting up, pride.

H1468.def: a primitive root (compare «01494»); properly, to shear off; but used only in the (figuratively) sense of passing rapidly:--bring, cut off.

H1469.def: or (shortened) gozal {go-zawl'}; from «01497»; a nestling (as being comparatively nude of feathers):--young (pigeon).

H1470.def: probably from «01468»; a quarry (as a place of cutting stones); Gozan, a province of Assyria:--Gozan.

H1471.et: apparently from the same root as (01465)
H1471.def: rarely (shortened) goy {go'-ee}; apparently from the same root as «01465» (in the sense of massing); a foreign nation; hence, a Gentile; also (figuratively) a troop of animals, or a flight of locusts:--Gentile, heathen, nation, people.

H1472.def: prolonged for «01465»; a body, whether alive or dead:--(dead) body, carcase, corpse.

H1473.def: or (shortened) golah {go-law'}; active participle feminine of «01540»; exile; concretely and collectively exiles:--(carried away), captive(-ity), removing.

H1474.def: from «01473»; captive; Golan, a place east of the Jordan:--Golan.

H1476.def: probably from «01598»; protected; Guni, the name of two Israelites:--Guni.

H1477.def: patronymically from «01476»; a Gunite (collectively with article prefix) or descendants of Guni:--Gunites.

H1478.def: a primitive root; to breathe out, i.e. (by implication) expire:--die, be dead, give up the ghost, perish.

H1479.def: a primitive root; properly, to hollow or arch, i.e. (figuratively) close; to shut:--shut.

H1480.def: from «01479»; a corpse (as closed to sense):--body.

H1481.def: a primitive root; properly, to turn aside from the road (for a lodging or any other purpose), i.e. sojourn (as a guest); also to shrink, fear (as in a strange place); also to gather for hostility (as afraid):--abide, assemble, be afraid, dwell, fear, gather (together), inhabitant, remain, sojourn, stand in awe, (be) stranger, × surely.

H1482.def: or (shortened) gur {goor}; perhaps from «01481»; a cub (as still abiding in the lair), especially of the lion:--whelp, young one.

H1483.def: the same as «01482»; Gur, a place in Palestine:--Gur.

H1485.def: from «01481» and «01168»; dwelling of Baal; Gur- Baal, a place in Arabia:--Gur-baal.

H1486.et: from an unused root meaning to be rough (as stone)
H1486.def: or (shortened) goral {go-ral'}; from an unused root meaning to be rough (as stone); properly, a pebble, i.e. a lot (small stones being used for that purpose); figuratively, a portion or destiny (as if determined by lot):--lot.

H1487.def: or rather (by permutation) giysh {gheesh}; of uncertain derivation; a mass of earth:--clod.

H1488.def: from «01494»; a fleece (as shorn); also mown grass:--fleece, mowing, mown grass.

H1491.def: a primitive root (akin to «01468»); to cut off, i.e. portion out:--take.

H1493.et: patrial from the unused name of a place
H1493.def: patrial from the unused name of a place apparently in Palestine; a Gizonite or inhabitant of Gizoh:--Gizonite.

H1494.def: a primitive root (akin to «01468»); to cut off; specifically to shear a flock or shave the hair; figuratively to destroy an enemy:--cut off (down), poll, shave, ((sheep-)) shear(-er).

H1495.def: from «01494»; shearer; Gazez, the name of two Israelites:--Gazez.

H1496.def: from «01491»; something cut, i.e. dressed stone:--hewed, hewn stone, wrought.

H1497.def: a primitive root; to pluck off; specifically to flay, strip or rob:--catch, consume, exercise (robbery), pluck (off), rob, spoil, take away (by force, violence), tear.

H1498.def: from «01497»; robbery, or (concretely) plunder:--robbery, thing taken away by violence.

H1499.def: from «01497»; plunder, i.e. violence:--violence, violent perverting. . gozal. See «01469».
